# Contributing

Contributions are welcome in three areas: new plugins, bug fixes, and documentation.

## Plugin contributions

- Add a new plugin under `plugins/` or `plugins/samples/`
- Include a `plugin.json` manifest
- Provide the runtime or tool source file
- Add any settings fields that the plugin needs
- Run `npm run validate:repo` before opening a pull request

## Bug reports

When reporting a bug, include:

- operating system
- Node version
- Electron or browser version if relevant
- reproduction steps
- expected result
- actual result

## Pull requests

Keep pull requests focused. Small, reviewable changes are preferred. If the change adds a new plugin, include a short description of what the plugin does and how it should be used.
